mcai.name: mcAI 1.0.1（Forge 26.1.2）
mcai.body:
mcAI for **Minecraft 26.1.2 / Forge**（Forge 版）

## 这个版本修了两个 bug

两个都不报错、不进日志，只是**画面上的东西凭空少一块**。

### 1. `/ai config` 里的文字整片看不见

26.1 在绘制文字时会读取颜色的 **alpha 通道**，`0xFFFFFF` 的意思变成了
「全透明的白」。于是配置界面的**标题、分组标题、底部提示、按键名**这些由
模组自己画的文字全部消失，而 vanilla 按钮自己的文字还在——所以界面看起来
像「只画了一半」，而不是整个坏掉。

现在所有传给文字绘制的颜色一律写成 `0xAARRGGBB`，并且
`tools/check_text_colors.py` 学会了 26.1 的新调用名
（`GuiGraphicsExtractor#text` / `#centeredText`），CI 里会直接挡住同类回归。

### 2. 两个切换器物品显示成紫黑错误贴图

1.21.4 起，物品除了 `models/item/<id>.json` 还需要一条
`items/<id>.json` 定义来绑定模型，26.1 版漏了这一步。已补齐。

## 其他

- 8 个语言文件补上 `key.categories.mcai.keys`（26.1 的按键分类翻译键走
  `key.categories.<namespace>`，缺了就在按键设置里显示成原始键名）。
- 配置文件 `config/mcai.json` 与 1.0.0 完全兼容，覆盖安装即可，不用重配。

## 安装

放进 `mods/`，需要 **Forge 64.1.5（26.1.2）** 与 **Java 25**。
核心链路（`!ai` 问答、`H/G/R/V` 截图识别）是纯客户端的，原版服务器也能用。

| 文件 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `mcai-forge-26.1-1.0.1.jar` | 装这个 |
| `mcai-forge-26.1-1.0.1-sources.jar` | 源码，不用装 |

mcai.name: mcAI 1.0.1（Fabric 26.1.2）
mcai.body:
mcAI for **Minecraft 26.1.2 / Fabric**

把 mcAI 搬到了 **Fabric 26.1.2**：功能与 1.21.11 / Forge 26.1 版一致
（`!ai` 问答、`H/G/R/V` 截图识别、配置界面、成本统计、多 Key 降级……全套都在），
换的是加载器与游戏 API 那一层。

## 26.1 这一版有什么不同

**Minecraft 26.1 起游戏不再混淆**：没有 Yarn、没有 intermediary，Loom 直接给带
Mojang 官方名的原版 jar。所以 Forge 26.1 与 Fabric 26.1 两个分支共用同一套
游戏 API 调用，差异只在装配层（入口点 / 事件 / 注册 / 网络）。
细节记在仓库的 `PORTING-26.1-FABRIC.md`。

## 顺手修掉的两个 bug

- **两个切换器物品显示成紫黑错误贴图**：1.21.4+ 需要 `assets/mcai/items/<id>.json`
  绑定模型，之前只带了 `models/item/`。已补齐。
- **`/ai config` 里自己画的文字看不见**：26.1 会读颜色的 alpha 通道，
  `0xFFFFFF` = 全透明。所有文字颜色统一写成 `0xAARRGGBB`，
  `tools/check_text_colors.py` 也认识了 26.1 的新调用名，CI 会挡住同类回归。

## 安装

放进 `mods/`，需要：

| 前置 | 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| Fabric Loader | ≥ 0.20.1 |
| Fabric API | 0.155.3+26.1.2 |
| Java | 25 |
| Mod Menu | 可选（18.0.2，装了才能从 Mod Menu 点进设置） |

核心链路（`!ai` 问答、`H/G/R/V` 截图识别）是纯客户端的，原版服务器也能用；
「切换器物品」的发放需要服务端也装本模组。

| 文件 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `mcai-fabric-26.1-1.0.1.jar` | 装这个 |
| `mcai-fabric-26.1-1.0.1-sources.jar` | 源码，不用装 |

> 分支：`fabric-26.1`。1.21.11 的玩家请继续用 `main` 分支的构建。

mcai.name: mcAI 1.0.0 — Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric)
mcai.body:
# mcAI 1.0.0 — Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric)

Version numbering restarts here for the 1.21.11 line. This is the whole 1.25.1 feature set ported to **Minecraft 1.21.11** — nothing dropped, nothing stubbed. Most of the work was API migration: 1.21.11 reworked input handling, GUI drawing, key binding categories, item creation, tooltips, text colours and the recipe tables.

---

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 1.21.11 |
| Loader | Fabric Loader **0.20.1** or newer |
| Fabric API | **0.141.6+1.21.11** or newer |
| Java | 21+ |
| Mod Menu | optional (in-game config shortcut) |

## Everything from 1.25.1, still working

- `!ai <question>` in chat, streaming answers, cancellable requests, automatic retry, per-call cost display, daily budget cap
- Vision: **H** full screenshot, **R** region picker, **G** build/redstone analysis, **V** crosshair inspect, optional preview + privacy mask
- Multiple API keys with failover, personas, long-term memory, per-world context
- Local (zero-token) helpers: inventory analysis, recipe lookup, sign/book translation, world-context advice
- Death recap, Discord webhook, danger alerts, text-to-speech
- Draggable whale HUD widget with usage rings, rebindable hotkeys, searchable config screen, 8 languages

## Fixed while porting

- **The config screen had no text at all — only the search box.** 1.21.11 feeds the colour you pass to `drawText` straight into the text render state and reads its alpha, so `0xFFFFFF` (the classic "white") is *fully transparent*. Every label the mod drew itself vanished, while vanilla widgets (which pass `0xFFFFFFFF`) stayed visible. All text colours now carry `FF`, and `tools/check_text_colors.py` fails the build if a 6-digit colour ever reaches a text call again.
- **Item textures rendered as the purple/black missing texture.** 1.21.4+ needs an `assets/mcai/items/<id>.json` definition on top of the old `models/item` file; without it the client never loads the model. Both definitions are in the jar, and `tools/check_jar.py` fails the build if a model, definition or referenced texture goes missing.
- **"Item id not set" crash on startup.** 1.21.11 requires a registry key on `Item.Settings` before the item is constructed.
- **"Category 'mcai:hud' is already registered".** Key binding categories are registered objects now, so the mod creates the category exactly once and shares it.
- The recipe helper reads the client recipe book, because `RecipeManager` no longer exposes iteration on the client.

## Verified

`gradlew build` green; brace-balance, language-sync, lang-usage, text-colour and jar-completeness checks all pass. A real 1.21.11 client launch initialises the mod, registers both switcher items (hotbar icons render with their real textures — zero missing-texture pixels in a pixel scan of the frame), hands them to the player and prints the feature guide in chat with no exceptions.

---

## 中文说明

**这是 mcAI 1.25.1 完整移植到 Minecraft 1.21.11（Fabric）的版本，功能一项不少；版本号从 1.0.0 重新起算。**

**这一轮修掉的真问题：**

1. **`/ai config` 界面只剩一个搜索框，其它文字全没了** —— 1.21.11 把传给 `drawText` 的颜色原样送进文字渲染状态并读取其 alpha，`0xFFFFFF` 等于「全透明白」。原版控件（传 `0xFFFFFFFF`）正常，模组自己画的标题、分组、行文字全部隐形。现在所有文字颜色都带 `FF`，并加了 `check_text_colors.py` 把这类问题卡在 CI。
2. **物品贴图紫黑格** —— 1.21.4 之后除 `models/item` 还需要 `items/<id>.json` 定义，缺了客户端根本不加载模型。已补齐并在 `check_jar.py` 里加了强校验。
3. **启动崩溃 "Item id not set"** —— 新版要求先给 `Item.Settings` 注册键。
4. **"Category 'mcai:hud' is already registered"** —— 按键分类变成注册对象，模组只创建一次、各处共用。

安装：丢进 `mods/`，配 Fabric API 与 Java 21。

mcai.name: mcAI Forge 26.1 — Minecraft 26.1.2 (Forge 64.1.5)
mcai.body:
# mcAI Forge 26.1 — Minecraft 26.1.2

The **Minecraft 26.1 edition** of mcAI: Forge **64.1.5**, Minecraft **26.1.2**,
**Java 25**.

This is the third edition of the same mod — `main` is Fabric 1.21.1,
`forge-1.20.1` is the 1.20.1 Forge line, and this branch (`forge-26.1`) targets
the 2026 versioning line. Each edition keeps its own version number, so this
release is the first of the 26.1 line. Every feature of the other two editions
is present; nothing was dropped to make the port work.

---

## What it does

Type `!ai <question>` in the chat bar to ask an AI. Press `H` to send a
screenshot, `R` to send only a region you drag, `G` to have it analyse a build
or a redstone circuit, `V` to ask what the block or mob under your crosshair is.

It is **client-side**: `!ai` messages are swallowed on the client and never reach
the server, so it works on any server — including ones you do not control.

Bring your own endpoint: any **OpenAI-compatible** API, **Google Gemini**,
**Anthropic Claude**, or a **local model** through Ollama / LM Studio (no key, no
cost, works offline).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| `!ai <question>` | Ask in chat. The message never leaves your client. |
| `H` / `R` / `G` / `V` | Screenshot / region screenshot / build-and-redstone analysis / crosshair inspect. |
| `/ai inv [question]` | Your inventory as text, analysed — about a tenth the cost of a screenshot. |
| `/ai read` | Translate the sign you look at or the book you hold — text, not an image. |
| `/ai craft [item]` | What you can craft right now, computed locally: **zero tokens**. |
| `/ai where [question]` | Coordinates, biome, light, dimension and health as context. |
| `/ai tl [lang] <text>` · `/ai tlang <lang>` | Translate, and set the default target language. |
| `/ai remember` · `/ai memories` · `/ai forget` | Long-term facts carried in every request. |
| `/ai cost` · `/ai budget <CNY>` · `/ai chart` | Spending, a hard daily cap, and a 7-day usage chart. |
| `/ai cache on\|off\|clear` | Asking the same question twice costs nothing the second time. |
| `/ai provider auto\|openai\|gemini\|claude` | Pick the API protocol, or infer it from your URL. |
| `/ai retry <0-5>` | Automatic retry with backoff on network failures and 429/5xx. |
| `/ai avatar on\|off\|edit\|image <path>` | HUD widget: usage bubble on `B`, position, your own PNG. |
| `/ai config` | Every option, grouped and searchable, editable in game. |
| `ESC` or `/ai cancel` | Really aborts the request in flight. |
| `/ai speak <text>` · `/ai tts on` | Reads answers aloud with the OS voice. |

Every answer carries the **real cost** of that call, computed from the usage the
provider returned, and clicking anywhere in an answer copies it.

**8 languages:** English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Русский, Español, Français —
chosen automatically from your game language.

---

## What 26.1 broke, and what was changed

26.1 is not a recompile of 1.20.1. The full reference is in
[`PORTING-26.1.md`](https://github.com/MFHRY/mcai/blob/forge-26.1/PORTING-26.1.md);
the short version:

**Toolchain.** ForgeGradle 7 and Gradle 9.5 — the `mappings channel:` block is
gone, the Forge artifact arrives through the mavenizer, and Java 25 is both the
toolchain and the bytecode level, because Mojang ships Java 25 to players from
26.1 on.

**EventBus 7.** There is no global event bus any more: every event owns its own
bus, and cancellable events take a predicate where returning `true` cancels.
`!ai` interception and item right-clicks are wired that way, so the
"works on any server" property survives verbatim.

**Rendering.** `GuiGraphics` became `GuiGraphicsExtractor`, `render` became
`extractRenderState`, `drawString` became `text`, `drawCenteredString` became
`centeredText`, `blit` now takes a target rect plus normalised UVs, and
`pose()` returns a 2D `Matrix3x2fStack` instead of a `PoseStack`. All three
custom screens and the HUD widget were ported to the new calls.

**Screenshots are asynchronous.** `Screenshot.takeScreenshot`

mcai.name: mcAI Forge 1.0.1 — Minecraft 1.20.1
mcai.body:
# mcAI Forge 1.0.1 — Minecraft 1.20.1

Fixes the 1.0.0 jar, which shipped **without `pack.mcmeta`** and therefore had no
working resources at all.

## Fixed

**Item models, textures and all 8 language files did not load.**

1.0.0 produced this in the log:

```
WARN Pack: Missing metadata in pack mod:mcai
WARN ModelBakery: Unable to load model: 'mcai:ai_model_switcher#inventory'
     java.io.FileNotFoundException: mcai:models/item/ai_model_switcher.json
```

The models **were** in the jar. Forge needs `pack.mcmeta` for a mod's resource
pack to be accepted; without it the whole pack is skipped, so every `mcai:`
resource — models, textures, translations — disappeared. Added. Verified against
a known-good Forge 1.20.1 mod (FerriteCore) that ships the same file.

Because the 1.0.0 item models never resolved, the two switcher items would have
shown as the purple/black missing texture. Language strings would have shown as
raw keys such as `mcai.cmd.status`.

## Added

**Switchable screen background** for `/ai config`, the region-select screen and
the send-preview screen — `/ai config` → **Screen background**:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Dim (vanilla)** | dark gradient over the game. Default — identical to before. |
| **Dirt** | classic tiled dirt background. |
| **Transparent** | no background; the game shows through. |
| **Custom image** | tiles any local PNG/JPG/WEBP you point it at. |

There is deliberately **no "blurred" option on 1.20.1**: menu blur
(`Screen.applyBlur` → `GameRenderer.renderBlur`) is a 1.21 API. It does not exist
in 1.20.1 — the ESC pause menu is not blurred there either.

A bad image path never breaks the screen: it logs a warning and falls back to the
dark gradient.

## Better logging

1.0.0 gave no way to tell whether the client-side modules had actually loaded. Now
each stage logs:

```
mcAI client modules: registering event listeners
mcAI client modules: 8 listeners registered (tick, commands, hud, chat, join, leave, item-use)
mcAI key mappings registered: H, G, R, V (screenshots) and B (widget bubble)
mcAI registered the /ai client command tree
mcAI: joined a world, scope = ...
```

## Requirements

Minecraft **1.20.1** · Forge **47.x** · **Java 17**

## Status

Compiles clean; 1.0.0 was also confirmed to load in a real game (mod
constructed, items registered, a world entered). The background feature in this
build has **not** been run yet.

## 中文

**修复**：1.0.0 的 jar 漏了 `pack.mcmeta`，导致模组资源包被跳过——物品模型、贴图、
8 个语言文件**全部不加载**。物品会显示成紫黑缺失贴图，文字会显示成 `mcai.cmd.status`
这样的原始键名。已补上。

**新增**：`/ai config`、框选截图、发送预览三个界面支持**可切换背景**——暗色渐变（原版默认）/
泥土 / 透明 / 自定义图片。**1.20.1 没有"模糊"选项**：菜单模糊是 1.21 才有的 API，
1.20.1 的 ESC 菜单本身也不模糊。

**日志**：补齐了客户端各环节的诊断日志，出问题能直接从日志定位。

# mcAI Forge 1.0.0 — Minecraft 1.20.1

The **Forge** edition of mcAI, for **Minecraft 1.20.1**.

This is its own version line: the Fabric edition is at 1.25.x, this one starts at
1.0.0. They are the same mod on different loaders, not the same jar — and the
Forge build has a shorter history, so inheriting the Fabric version number would
misrepresent it.

---

Type `!ai <question>` in the Minecraft chat bar to ask an AI. Press `H` to send a

Bring your own endpoint:

- **Google Gemini**, or

| `/ai config` | Every option, grouped and searchable, editable in game. |

mcai.name: mcAI 1.25.1
mcai.body:
# mcAI 1.25.1

A security-hygiene fix for the text-to-speech feature. Nothing else changed.

---

## Fixed

**TTS no longer launches PowerShell with a Base64-encoded command.**

The text to speak used to be Base64-encoded and interpolated into
`powershell.exe -Command "..."`. That *was* safe against command injection — the Base64 alphabet
contains nothing PowerShell would treat as code — but:

> a Java mod that reads arbitrary files, calls the network, and then runs PowerShell on a Base64 blob

is indistinguishable from malware to an automated scanner, and Modrinth runs one during review.
It is also the kind of pattern antivirus engines flag on users' machines.

The text now goes to the child process over **stdin**, and the command line is a fixed literal
string:

```powershell
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech
$s = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer
$t = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
if ($t.Trim().Length -gt 0) { $s.Speak($t) }
```

That is strictly safer — the text never reaches the command line at all, so there is nothing to
escape — and it no longer resembles obfuscation.

## Unchanged

TTS still speaks the same text, still stays silent if the OS has no speech component, and still
needs `/ai tts on` first. Every 1.25 feature (crosshair inspect, inventory analysis, Gemini/Claude,
automatic retry, per-call cost, click-to-copy answers, rebindable hotkeys, the searchable config
screen, the HUD whale widget, and all 8 languages) is exactly as it was.

---

## 中文版

### 修复

**TTS 不再用 Base64 编码后启动 PowerShell。**

以前待朗读的文本会被 Base64 编码再拼进 `powershell.exe -Command "..."`。那样**确实**防住了
命令注入（Base64 字符集里没有 PowerShell 会当成代码的东西），但是：

> 一个会读任意文件、会联网、还会对 Base64 数据跑 PowerShell 的 Java 模组

在自动化扫描器眼里和恶意软件没有区别——Modrinth 审核时就会跑扫描器，杀软在玩家机器上
也盯这类模式。

现在文本改走 **stdin**，命令行是一段固定常量（见上方脚本）。这更安全：文本根本不进命令行，
也就无所谓转义；同时不再命中混淆特征。

### 没有变化的部分

朗读的还是同样的文本，系统没有语音组件时照样静默失败，仍然要先 `/ai tts on`。
1.25 的全部功能（准星查询、物品栏分析、Gemini/Claude、自动重试、每次调用花费、
点击复制回答、可改键、可搜索的设置界面、HUD 鲸鱼娘挂件、8 种语言）都完全一致。

---

## 包装 / Packaging

| 文件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `mcai-1.25.1.jar` | 放进 `.minecraft/mods/` 就能用（需要 Fabric API） |
| `mcai-1.25.1-sources.jar` | 源码，只在你想自己编译/改代码时需要 |

- 需要 **Minecraft 1.21.1 + Fabric Loader + [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**
- 客户端和服务端都要装（`environment: "*"`）
- 内置 8 种语言的界面：English / 简体中文 / 繁體中文 / 日本語 / 한국어 / Русский / Español / Français

mcai.name: mcAI 1.25
mcai.body:
# mcAI 1.25

Ten changes, most of them about **spending less** and **asking more naturally**.

---

## New

### Ask in more ways

- **Crosshair inspect (`V`)** — look at a block or mob and press `V`. The mod sends its name
  *and* its registry id (`modid:block`), so the model can tell two different mods' "copper
  block" apart, and knows it is looking at modded content at all. Mobs also carry their health,
  which is the number that actually decides whether to fight.
- **One-command inventory analysis (`/ai inv [question]`)** — your inventory as a compact text
  list, plus your own question. The same information sent as a screenshot costs roughly ten
  times as much.
- **Gemini and Claude support** — the request/response layer is now split per vendor and
  normalises everything back into one shape, so token stats, costing and history keep working
  unchanged. `api_provider` defaults to `auto` and infers the protocol from your `api_url`;
  `/ai provider gemini` forces it if the guess is wrong.

### Spend less

- **What each call actually cost** — appended to every answer, computed from the `usage` the
  provider really returned rather than from the pre-flight estimate. Previously you only saw a
  rough number *before* sending, and never the real one afterwards.
- **Automatic retry** — network failures and 408/425/429/5xx are retried with exponential
  backoff (default 2 retries, `/ai retry 0..5`). Other 4xx responses are deliberately **not**
  retried: the request itself is wrong, and retrying only makes you wait longer for the same error.

### Use it more comfortably

- **Click any answer to copy it.** Coordinates and 「item names」 keep their own click actions;
  clicking anywhere else copies the whole reply.
- **Rebindable hotkeys** — `H` / `G` / `R` / `V` can all be changed from the in-game config
  screen. The binding is still stored by vanilla in `options.txt`; no second copy is kept in
  `mcai.json`, because two sources of truth for one keybind is a bug factory.
- **Searchable, grouped config screen** — `/ai config` is now split into collapsible sections
  with a search box, instead of one long list.
- **A whale companion on your HUD** — squashes when you hold `Q`, and pops a bubble with
  today's spend, budget remaining, the peak/off-peak countdown, current model and persona,
  cache hits and your account balance. Toggle the bubble with `B`, position it with
  `/ai avatar edit`, point it at your own PNG with `/ai avatar image <path>`, hide it with
  `/ai avatar off`. Not mouse-driven on purpose: a HUD element cannot receive clicks in vanilla,
  and this mod ships no mixin to change that. **No artwork is bundled** — bring your own, which
  also keeps this project's CC0 licence covering nothing but code.

### Also

- The on-join guide and `/ai help` now list **every** command. In 1.23 and 1.24 the built-in
  guide had fallen behind the command list, so translation, the chat trigger prefix, and all of
  1.24's commands were undiscoverable in game. The on-join message is now a short version and
  points at `/ai help` for the full list.

---

## 中文版

十项改动，大部分围绕**少花钱**和**问得更自然**。

### 新增

**更多提问方式**

- **准星查询（V 键）**——看着方块或生物按 V。发送的是名字**加上注册 ID**（`modid:block`），
  模型能分清两个模组各自的"铜块"，也知道自己面对的是模组内容。生物额外带血量。
- **物品栏一键分析（`/ai inv [问题]`）**——把背包整理成文字清单再提问，
  同样的信息发截图大约贵十倍。
- **支持 Gemini / Claude**——请求响应按厂商拆开再归一化，统计和计费不受影响。
  `/ai provider auto|openai|gemini|claude`，默认 `auto` 按接口地址判断。

**更省钱**

- **每次调用的真实花费**——附在每条回答末尾，按服务商实际返回的 `usage` 结算。
- **失败自动重试**——网络异常和 408/425/429/5xx 按指数退避重试，其余 4xx 刻意不重试。

**更顺手**

- **点一下复制整段回答**（坐标和物品名保留各自的点击行为）
- **快捷键可自定义**：`H` / `G` / `R` / `V`，在 `/ai config` 里改
- **设置界面分组 + 搜索**
- **HUD 鲸鱼娘挂件**：按住 `Q` 会 Q 弹。气泡显示花费 / 预算 / 峰谷倒计时 / 模型人格 /
  缓存命中 / 账户余额。气泡用 `B` 开关，位置用 `/ai avatar edit`，头像用
  `/ai avatar image <PNG 路径>` 指定你自己的图，`/ai avatar off` 隐藏。
  （刻意不做鼠标交互：原版 HUD 元素收不到点击，本模组也不打算为此引入 mixin。）
  **不内置任何美术素材**——用你自己的图，本项目的 CC0 也就只覆盖代码。

### 说明

- 没有删除或改名任何配置项，旧的 `config/mcai.json` 可以直接用。

# mcAI 1.24

The biggest update since 1.20: **13 new features**, most of them about spending less money
and sending less of your screen to a third party.

## New

**Cost control**

- **Selectable region screenshots (`R`)** — drag a box and only that part is sent. Image
  tokens scale with pixel count, so framing 40% of the screen costs 40% of the image.
- **Pre-send preview** — see the exact processed image (cropped, masked, resized) before it
  leaves your machine. Off by default: `/ai preview on`.
- **Privacy mask** — the chat area is blacked out before upload, so chat logs and player
  names never reach the provider. Off by default: `/ai mask on`.
- **Spend estimate before every request** — one dim line telling you roughly what this
  question will cost.
- **Budget warning at 80%** — previously the only feedback was being blocked *after* the
  budget was gone.
- **Local answer cache** — asking the same question twice costs nothing the second time.

**Better answers**

- **Modlist + version awareness** — the system prompt now carries the game version and the
  loaded mod list, so the model stops answering "that does not exist in vanilla" when you
  are clearly running a modpack. `/ai env off` disables it.
- **Long-term memory** — `/ai remember <text>` keeps facts (base coordinates, current
  project) in every request. `/ai memories`, `/ai forget <n>`, `/ai forget all`.

**Control and safety**

- **Cancel a request** — `ESC` (or `/ai cancel`). Previously a request could only be waited
  out or timed out at 60–90 seconds, and the model kept generating — and billing — the
  whole time. Cancelling now really aborts the HTTP exchange.
- **Danger alert** — optionally screenshot and ask for advice when health is low with
  hostile mobs nearby. `/ai danger on`. Fires only on the moment health crosses the
  threshold, then enforces a cooldown, so it cannot spam.
- **Clickable coordinates in answers** — coordinates are copied to the clipboard on click;
  「item names」 are offered as a chat suggestion. Clicking only copies or fills the box,
  never executes anything.
- **Multi-turn context is now per world/server** — fixes a real bug: history used to be a
  single global queue, so after leaving a singleplayer world and joining a server the AI
  still remembered the previous world's coordinates.
- **Mod Menu integration** — the settings screen is now reachable from Mod Menu, not just
  from `/ai config`. Mod Menu stays an *optional* dependency.
- **Text-to-speech** — read answers out loud via the OS speech synthesizer
  (`/ai tts on`, `/ai speak <text>`).

## Fixed

- `fabric.mod.json` still advertised "(English / Chinese)" after 1.23 added 繁體中文 and
  日本語. It now lists all four languages.
- The vision path used a bare system prompt with no persona; chat and screenshots now build
  the system prompt through the same code, so they cannot drift apart.

> **Packaging note:** only `mcai-1.24.jar` goes in `mods`. Do not put the `-sources.jar`
> there — it carries a `fabric.mod.json` with the same mod id and an unexpanded
> `${version}`, so Fabric sees two mods named `mcai`.

- Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric Loader >= 0.19.5, Java 21
- Optional: **Mod Menu** (adds the settings button in the mod list)
- Your `mcai.json` is fully compatible — every new option has a working default.

---

# mcAI 1.23

**Two new languages.** Nothing else changed — no behaviour changes, no config changes.

## New

- **繁體中文 (`zh_tw`)** — a full Traditional Chinese translation, 258 strings. Written for
  Taiwanese conventions rather than a character-by-character conversion: 螢幕 / 設定 /
  儲存 / 伺服器 / 網路 / 生態域 / 座標. The AI system prompts are localized too, so the
  model answers in Traditional Chinese.
- **日本語 (`ja_jp`)** — a full Japanese translation, 258 strings. The AI system prompts,
  persona suffixes and translation prompts are localized as well, so the model answers in
  Japanese without you having to change any setting.

The mod now ships **four** languages in one jar:

| File | Language |
| --- | --- |
| `en_us.json` | English |
| `zh_cn.json` | 简体中文 |
| `zh_tw.json` | 繁體中文 |
| `ja_jp.json` | 日本語 |

It follows your Minecraft language setting automatically — nothing to configure.

> **Packaging note:** only `mcai-1.23.jar` goes in `mods`. Do not put the `-sources.jar`
> there — it carries a `fabric.mod.json` with the same mod id and an unexpanded
> `${version}`, so Fabric sees two mods named `mcai`.

- Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric Loader >= 0.19.5, Java 21
- Your `mcai.json` is fully compatible — nothing to reconfigure.

---

# mcAI 1.23（中文）

**只新增两个语言，其他一律没动**——行为没有变化，配置文件也没有变化。

## 新增

- **繁體中文（`zh_tw`）**：完整的繁體中文翻译，258 条。是按台湾用语习惯写的，**不是逐字转换**：
  螢幕 / 設定 / 儲存 / 伺服器 / 網路 / 生態域 / 座標。AI 系统提示词也一并本地化，
  模型会直接用繁體中文回答。
- **日本語（`ja_jp`）**：完整的日语翻译，258 条。AI 系统提示词、人格后缀和翻译提示词
  也一并本地化，切到日语后模型直接用日语回答，不需要改任何设置。

现在同一个 jar 里带 **四种语言**：

| 文件 | 语言 |
| --- | --- |
| `en_us.json` | English |
| `zh_cn.json` | 简体中文 |
| `zh_tw.json` | 繁體中文 |
| `ja_jp.json` | 日本語 |

跟随游戏语言自动切换，不需要任何配置。

> **打包提醒：** 只有 `mcai-1.23.jar` 放进 `mods`。不要把 `-sources.jar` 放进去——
> 它带着同一个 mod id 且版本号是未替换的 `${version}`，Fabric 会看到两个叫 `mcai` 的 mod。

- Minecraft 1.21.1，Fabric Loader >= 0.19.5，Java 21
- `mcai.json` 完全兼容，不需要重新配置。
